'''Engle''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served with [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Engle flew a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] launched an [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|assault]] on [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was shot down by vulture droids and crashed in the ventral [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay of the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']]. He miraculously survived the terrifying crash and Kenobi helped Engle to safety from the wreckage of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. He evacuated the ''Negotiator'' alongside the rest of the crew before its subsequent self-destruction.
